label: Product engineering
headline: Why we run OCR on the phone, not on a server
body: The photo never leaves the device. No upload, no queue, no OCR server to pay for.

label: Data products
headline: Public data as a product: the checklist

checks.text: Pick one domain and one source family
Link records into entities people recognise
Score with inputs the user can see
Price the saved work, not the free input

label: Product engineering
headline: Every part of a product gets one verdict.
body: A product audit is not a list of complaints. It decides what to keep, what to fix and what to replace.

items: The design is sound. Fix the local problems and keep shipping.
The design is under strain. Change the structure in steps, behind tests.
Only the part that cannot support what the product now has to do.
Complex and unused. Often the best verdict.

quote.text: If the data never leaves the device, you do not need to ask people to trust you with it.
quote.speaker: LucidReactor Labs
quote.context: Privacy-first architecture for consumer apps, in plain language

label: How we work
headline: Four decisions, in the right order.

steps.title: Frame the problem
steps.text: One user, one important decision and the evidence that would show progress.

steps.title: Prototype the decision
steps.text: Make the core journey visible early enough to test the reasoning, not just the interface.

steps.title: Build the smallest complete product
steps.text: A narrow end-to-end experience with the trust, recovery and measurement it needs.

steps.title: Launch, measure and improve
steps.text: Real behaviour and direct feedback choose the next problem.
